summary: amazon.aws removed parameter aliases boto_profile, ec2_access_key, ec2_region, ec2_secret_key and endpoint/ec2_url/s3_url, plus the aws_credentials and aws_region docs fragments.
questions: Is boto_profile still accepted in amazon.aws modules?
What replaced the ec2_url parameter alias?

answer_card.title: amazon.aws removed parameter aliases
answer_card.answer_md:
Removed aliases in amazon.aws (use the canonical name):

- `boto_profile` → `profile`
- `ec2_access_key` → `access_key`
- `ec2_region` → `region`
- `ec2_secret_key` → `secret_key`
- `endpoint`, `ec2_url`, `s3_url` → `endpoint_url`
- Also removed: `session_token` aliases `access_token`, `aws_security_token`, `security_token`.

Docs fragments removed: `amazon.aws.aws_credentials` (use `amazon.aws.common.plugins`) and `amazon.aws.aws_region` (use `amazon.aws.region.plugins`).
